title: How Losing God Saved My Life: A Deconstruction of Damaging Scriptures

top_liked.author: @amyeck3870
top_liked.text: Same! I felt like god hated me and was pushing me for everything that was done to me! The relief I felt when I realized there was no god! I’m free and I know now that all the evil that was happening to me was because of a twisted belief in god!

top_liked.author: @Jasper-t5s

top_liked.author: @Crimenocerous
top_liked.text: “If there’s already a plan for me, how can I screw it up? Why should I put effort into learning something, pushing through the struggle and doubt when those could very easily be interpreted as my sign that these are NOT the plan?” Wasted a lot of years with that sort of thinking.

top_liked.author: @RadRebel73
top_liked.text: While some of my childhood friends were interested in riding the church bus to church on Sun. I always stayed home and spent my time outside in nature catching frogs, snakes, salamanders, and crawfish.

top_liked.author: @oldschoolman1444
top_liked.text: I always had a hard time being told we were born sinners and all that don't believe are condemned to hell to suffer for eternity.

top_liked.author: @AuroraBoarder1
top_liked.text: Losing faith in God didn’t make me feel liberated. It made me extremely bewildered.  I had to take on huge burdens.  But on the bright side, I accomplished a lot more than I did as a Christian.

top_liked.author: @Skeloric
top_liked.text:
Too much of my trials and tribulations had a human source.
I stopped watching the puppet show and began looking for the puppet master.
Weird how my life began improving once I looked for the very natural sources to my misfortunes.
